rungs.no_gate: M146 is a measuring stick: no win/loss gate; its outcome selects the shipping mode.
rungs.r1: frozen codes + closed-form ridge (the C4 fitter, penalties {0.1, 1.0, 10.0}, best reported) — the t1 anchor itself
rungs.r2: frozen transformed codes + TRAINED linear head (the M109 t2 pattern; the E5 read on the promoted codes)
rungs.r3: trainable dictionary + trained head through the differentiable SPM+sqrt encoder (the gradients-through-the-code cell); whitener frozen
rungs.shipping_map: r3 clearly above r1 -> gradients pay on the winner -> hybrid / trained-small shipping; r3 below r1 (the M109 sealed answer) -> the frozen system ships.

schedule.note: the M109 registered shared schedule, unchanged (AdamW, cosine, patience 2), so M146 reads against M109's sealed t2/t3 under one schedule.
